dialogue.text: The boxes are your main way of obtaining pins.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Each box has set rarities it can pick to give a pin from.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Said rarities and their chances are listed in the bottom-right.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text:
From there,<d=0.25/> the pin chosen from the rarity is purely random,
only the rarities are weighed.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: It has a cap of 125% though, so once you know you're on Loop #49, you know it's maxed.
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia

dialogue.text: Long plays deserve a good payout,<d=0.5/> no?
dialogue.speaker: Ophelia
